subject: Copywriting
title: Social Proof Headlines
description: Learn Social Proof Headlines in one minute.

hook.text: '10 Million People Use This App'—numbers in headlines create social proof. If others do it, it must be good.

buildup.text: Cialdini's research showed people follow crowds. A headline citing user numbers taps tribal instinct.

discovery.text: 'Join 50,000 Subscribers' outperforms 'Subscribe Now.' The number does the persuading. Copy just frames it.

twist.text: Social proof backfires when numbers are small. '12 people liked this' makes readers avoid, not join.

climax.text: The trick is matching proof to audience size. A niche audience respects '200 experts.' Mass needs millions.

punchline.text: If millions do it, it must be good. That's social proof.

quiz.question: When does social proof in headlines backfire?
options: When the numbers are very large
